title: Principal Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Principal Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As Principal Concept Artist you will work with the development teams to create memorable environments along with unique and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in both character and environment design will provide the inspiration which will continue to push the boundaries of what Fornite means to our players.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize many different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Inspire, mentor, and manage a team of Concept Artists and outsourcing vendors
  • Provide timely & detailed feedback for the concept art team and outsourcing vendors
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product

What we're looking for

  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Lead or Principal Concept Artist role
  • Portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity and craftsmanship
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • 7 + years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Snaps are next-generation software packaging and delivery for Linux. They are designed for safety, security and robustness, with application-specific confinement of containers optimised for IoT devices, desktops and servers. Our goal is that snaps work across multiple Linux flavors to ensure that publishers have the simplest way to reach the whole Linux world.
This role requires an obsession with quality and performance, for work at the heart of the operating system. It also requires an interest in the software publishing and consumption experience. Applicants should be passionate about open source software development. We value collaboration, peer reviews, good unit/integration testing and maintainable code.   • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Obsess over how to achieve robustness despite unexpected events like power outages
  • Work from home with global travel for up to two weeks, twice a year
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills, are thoughtful and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

  • Auxiliar na padronização de processos técnicos corporativos;
  • Realizar outras atividades pertinentes ao cargo, conforme necessidade do setor.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Superior completo em Farmácia ou Ciências Biológicas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação e/ou Mestrado e Doutorado;

  • Benefícios para a Família: Eu cuido dos meus pais;
  • Dentre outros benefícios.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ART
What We Do
Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.
What You'll Do
Epic is looking for a talented Principal Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As Principal Concept Artist you will work with the development teams to create memorable environments along with unique and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in both character and environment design will provide the inspiration which will continue to push the boundaries of what Fornite means to our players.
In this role, you will

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize many different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Inspire, mentor, and manage a team of Concept Artists and outsourcing vendors
  • Provide timely & detailed feedback for the concept art team and outsourcing vendors
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product

What We're Looking For
  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Lead or Principal Concept Artist role
  • Portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity and craftsmanship
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • 7 + years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.
About Us
Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.
Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!
Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.
Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here.

  • Experience building and maintaining robust data pipelines and features for ML workflows.
  • Solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms, model evaluation techniques, and common pitfalls.
  • Familiarity with MLflow or similar frameworks for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.
  • Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD integration for ML.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in English.
  • Curiosity, humility, and a drive to continuously improve yourself and the products you build.

Nice to have:
  • Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, SageMaker, ECR, and CloudWatch.
  • Exposure to tools in our tech stack: MLflow, Airflow, dbt, Tableau, GitHub, PostreSQL.
  • Understanding of MLOps best practices (monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines).
  • Previous experience in the iGaming, sports betting, or digital media industries

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Who We Are

Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Experience Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network – even the ones they don’t own. Powered by AI and an unmatched set of cloud, internet and enterprise network telemetry data, ThousandEyes enables IT teams to proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate issues – before they impact end- user experiences.

ThousandEyes is deeply integrated across the entire Cisco technology portfolio and beyond, helping customers deploy at scale while also delivering AI-powered assurance insights within Cisco’s leading Networking, Security, Collaboration, and Observability portfolios.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) on the Scale team at ThousandEyes, you will manage a segment of accounts with high propensity to grow, using a combination of strategic engagements and scalable programs to drive success across the customer lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of SaaS, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to lead both one-to-one and one-to-many customer engagements.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor—driving onboarding success, accelerating platform adoption, and leading proactive motions such as QBRs, monthly check-ins, and health reviews. You’ll also act as the voice of the customer, advocating for their needs internally while setting clear and actionable expectations externally.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to promote long-term success, adoption, and retention.
  • Own and manage a portfolio of customers that require both high-touch and scale engagement methods.
  • Conduct strategic touchpoints including monthly check-ins, QBRs, platform health checks, and de-risking motions.
  • Proactively identify customer risks before they surface; mobilize and project manage internal teams to address issues swiftly and effectively.
  • Drive adoption of key platform features that enhance customer outcomes and improve retention.
  • Ensure customers achieve success with ThousandEyes use cases, validated through business metrics and data insights.
  • Deeply understand each customer’s business, market conditions, technology stack, and key stakeholders to identify expansion opportunities and potential for vendor consolidation.
  • Forecast and track customer sentiment, product utilization, and key health indicators.
  • Partner with Pre-Sales and Adoption Engineering teams to drive collaboration, expansion, and successful renewals.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer, collecting product feedback and prioritizing requirements based on risk, urgency, and revenue impact.
  • Set appropriate expectations with customers while coordinating internal resources to deliver high-impact items.
  • Help manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical customer issues.
Qualifications
  • At least 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals in a SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle, including risk identification and mitigation.
  • Proven success managing customer portfolios through both high-touch and scale strategies.
  • Excellent communication, listening, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English, with the confidence and presence to engage executive stakeholders.
  • Must be available and ready to work during core U.S. business hours.
  • Organized, proactive, and highly accountable with strong project management and multitasking skills.
  • Collaborative and cross-functional, with the ability to influence across internal teams.
  • Proficient in CRM tools like Salesforce and data-driven in your approach.
  • Technically curious and able to understand and explain software and cloud technologies.
  • Data-driven with the ability to interpret and act on customer insights and performance metrics.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience in SaaS and cloud-based solutions.

Cisco values the perspectives and skills that emerge from employees with diverse backgrounds. That's why Cisco is expanding the boundaries of discovering top talent by not only focusing on candidates with educational degrees and experience but also placing more emphasis on unlocking potential. We believe that everyone has something to offer and that diverse teams are better equipped to solve problems, innovate, and create a positive impact.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification . Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification. Research shows that people from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy. We urge you not to prematurely exclude yourself and to apply if you're interested in this work.

description:

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, Managed Services role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager ...
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and Cloud technologies to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
The BootStack team designs, builds, and operates modern distributed systems on private infrastructure for customers. From Kubernetes to OpenStack and everything in-between, you'll be working with the latest technology in a fast-paced engineering environment. As a Cloud Engineering Manager for the BootStack team, you will be responsible for managing the engineers that oversee day-to-day Managed Service of customer environments, including customer service management, managed services operations and consistent product improvement engineering. Collaboration with customers, product engineering, and operations is critical to success.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails

  • Manage a growing engineering team to optimise the quality and velocity of both development and operations
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering and operations processes
  • Represent the BootStack team with respect to stakeholders, customers, and external teams
  • Ensure proper team focus on priorities, milestones, and deliverables
  • Work to meet service level agreements with customer deployments around the globe
  • Deliver quality managed services in a consistent, timely manner
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelors (or equivalent) education in a technology field
  • Proven track record of professional experience of either software delivery using Python, Go, C, C++, Java, or similar and/or managing operations teams
  • Proven experience with OpenStack
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Experience with Linux system administration, Ubuntu/Debian a plus
  • Strong communication and cooperation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Experience working in and managing distributed teams
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud topologies and technologies
  • Travel to team and company events and customer meetings, roughly 20% or less
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: Security Software Engineer
description:

Join to apply for the Security Software Engineer role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Security Software Engineer role at Canonical

This is a general track for security-focused engineering in every team at Canonical, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an exceptional security-focused software engineer.
Most product engineering teams at Canonical include one or two spaces for dedicated security-oriented software engineers. Their role is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security. They contribute to the product as engineers too, but their primary focus is to improve security through state of the art practices - from table-top threat model exercises to architecture reviews, from extended security testing with fuzzers and static analysis tools to external security analyst liaison.
We also build a number of products that are entirely motivated by security technology and requirements, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and our hardening, compliance and certification toolkits for Ubuntu.
As the publisher of Ubuntu we also handle long-term security response and hardening for the entire operating system and open source universe. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language, and design, build and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security and open source community participation. All security roles interact closely with many of the other Canonical engineering and development teams, Canonical customers and our partners across the open source community.
Location: We have open roles for security specialist software engineers in every timezone.
What you'll do
Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement and document new security features
  • Lead security-oriented thinking in a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in Canonical and open source Software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools in our security infrastructure, pipelines and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components - specifically with modules such as OpenSSL/Libgcrypt - with the features and functionality required for country-specific compliance such as FIPS and CC certification
  • Work with external partners to develop CIS benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Monitor the security industry for new developments
  • Develop, test and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • A thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities
  • Modern engineering techniques to find and fix them
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby or PHP
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Optional skills we also value
  • Clear and effective communication with the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with Linux Kernel
  • Security Certification experience and knowledge in FIPS and/or CC
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated high learning ability
  • Performance engineering experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

description:

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager ...
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and Cloud technologies to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
The BootStack team designs, builds, and operates modern distributed systems on private infrastructure for customers. From Kubernetes to OpenStack and everything in-between, you'll be working with the latest technology in a fast-paced engineering environment. As a Cloud Engineering Manager for the BootStack team, you will be responsible for managing the engineers that oversee day-to-day Managed Service of customer environments, including customer service management, managed services operations and consistent product improvement engineering. Collaboration with customers, product engineering, and operations is critical to success.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails

  • Manage a growing engineering team to optimise the quality and velocity of both development and operations
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering and operations processes
  • Represent the BootStack team with respect to stakeholders, customers, and external teams
  • Ensure proper team focus on priorities, milestones, and deliverables
  • Work to meet service level agreements with customer deployments around the globe
  • Deliver quality managed services in a consistent, timely manner
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelors (or equivalent) education in a technology field
  • Proven track record of professional experience of either software delivery using Python, Go, C, C++, Java, or similar and/or managing operations teams
  • Proven experience with OpenStack
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Experience with Linux system administration, Ubuntu/Debian a plus
  • Strong communication and cooperation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Experience working in and managing distributed teams
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud topologies and technologies
  • Travel to team and company events and customer meetings, roughly 20% or less
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Senior Operations Specialist role at HDR

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?
Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
HDR is looking for an energetic, hard working problem solver to become a full time Senior Operations Specialist to work on both municipal and industrial water treatment facilities. If you are someone who is looking to work on a variety of treatment technologies for multiple treatment plants, then this position will be for you. This individual will work on water treatment projects that can range from small municipalities to some of the most iconic in the United States. Our engineering staff rely heavily upon our Operations Specialist staff to create solutions with better reliability and improved operability for our clients.
You will not only be a part of our East Region team, but will be a key member of HDR’s nationwide Operations Team. This team is made up of other experienced maintenance and operations experts, and coordinate to share best practices, experience, and opportunities to utilize every team member’s unique expertise. We currently have extensive project backlog in throughout the United States, so you will be able to immediately contribute to our success.
The work location will be at the HDR office closest to your current location. Please check the HDR website nearest to you.
About Us
For over 100 years, HDR has specialized in engineering, architecture, environmental and construction services. We provide solutions to thousands of partners, from small local utilities to the largest global companies. HDR has nearly 13,000 employee owners worldwide and ENR ranked in the top 10 of Water design firms, Water Treatment and Desalination design firms, and Wastewater design firms. Our Water Business Group has over 2,000 employee owners, with over 500 in our Eastern Region.
At HDR, we know work isn’t only about who you work for; it’s also about what you do and how you do it. Led by the strength of our values and a culture shaped by employee ownership, we network with each other, build on each other’s contributions, and collaborate together to make great things possible. When you join HDR, we give you license to do the same. We help you take charge of your career, giving you multiple growth opportunities along the way.
Primary Responsibilities

  • Support HDR project leaders at the local, state, and regional level on water treatment projects requiring input from Operations Specialists.
  • Review drawings for operability review and HazOps analysis with an eye for what it takes to successfully operate a variety of treatment processes successfully.
  • Manage operations and maintenance projects with both municipal and industrial clients. It will involve client interfacing, regulatory reporting, as well as personnel, subcontractor, and maintenance management.
  • Develop startup and commissioning plans and host workshops to share those ideas with client’s contractors and operators to ensure the plan will work for each specific plant.
  • Perform startup and commissioning of new water treatment facilities. This work involves you playing a key role in working alongside contractors and engineers to ensure the new equipment functions correctly before handing it over to the operations and maintenance staff.
  • Perform formal and informal training to help our clients’ treatment plants operate as well as they can operate.
  • Participate in the testing of facilities to ensure they are ready for startup and after startup they meet the capacity requirements of the design.
  • Perform condition assessment and asset management tasks on water and wastewater facilities, using state of the art evaluation tools to efficiently capture the information and opinions that you generate.
  • Perform operational or maintenance troubleshooting and evaluations on municipal and industrial water facilities.
Work will involve a base of projects in the southern portion of the central United States, but will also include projects in several sites across the country. It provides the opportunity to work on a variety of new and innovative projects, and provides a career path that has more growth than typical utility organizations.
This job may require 30 to 40% travel, more is possible. Weekend travel is normally not required.
Strongly Preferred Qualifications
  • Minimum 10 years field experience in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation equipment at water treatment facilities and/or resolving water treatment process problems. Additional construction experience is a plus.
  • High level water treatment operator license or professional engineering license.
  • Ability to interpret engineering plans and specifications.

  • Valid driver’s license.

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. title: Security Software Engineer
description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This is a general track for security-focused engineering in every team at Canonical, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an exceptional security-focused software engineer.
Most product engineering teams at Canonical include one or two spaces for dedicated security-oriented software engineers. Their role is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security. They contribute to the product as engineers too, but their primary focus is to improve security through state of the art practices - from table-top threat model exercises to architecture reviews, from extended security testing with fuzzers and static analysis tools to external security analyst liaison.
We also build a number of products that are entirely motivated by security technology and requirements, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and our hardening, compliance and certification toolkits for Ubuntu.
As the publisher of Ubuntu we also handle long-term security response and hardening for the entire operating system and open source universe. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language, and design, build and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security and open source community participation. All security roles interact closely with many of the other Canonical engineering and development teams, Canonical customers and our partners across the open source community.
Location: We have open roles for security specialist software engineers in every timezone.
What you'll do
Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement and document new security features
  • Lead security-oriented thinking in a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in Canonical and open source Software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools in our security infrastructure, pipelines and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components - specifically with modules such as OpenSSL/Libgcrypt - with the features and functionality required for country-specific compliance such as FIPS and CC certification
  • Work with external partners to develop CIS benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Monitor the security industry for new developments
  • Develop, test and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • A thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities
  • Modern engineering techniques to find and fix them
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Job Description
Job Title: Sr. Manager- NPI Engineering Sourcing
Job Overview
As Sr. Manager- NPI Engineering Sourcing at Nextracker, you will play a critical role in driving the sourcing strategy and execution for new Electrical and Power conversion product introductions. You will manage procurement activities related to new product BOMs and first factory setup, ensuring alignment with business objectives and critical timelines.
Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing Strategy Development: Lead the development and execution of sourcing strategies for new product initiatives, ensuring timely and cost-effective solutions. Own and maintain up to date CBOM at all times of development.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, quality assurance, and sourcing teams to align sourcing activities with product launch schedules, driving successful new product introductions.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide consistent project updates to senior management and other stakeholders regarding sourcing strategies, project progress, and any necessary adjustments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks associated with new product sourcing in collaboration with sourcing managers, and develop robust mitigation strategies to address these risks.
  • Project Scheduling Coordination: Develop detailed project schedules for procurement milestones that align with overall program schedules and cost targets, ensuring that project teams work in conjunction with category strategies.
  • Procurement Activity Oversight: Manage quotes, purchase orders, deliveries, and all procurement activities to support project needs effectively.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor project progress, make timely adjustments as needed, and measure performance to identify areas for improvement.
  • Milestone Monitoring: Monitor key milestones, ensuring adherence to identified timelines and deliverables for key objectives within assigned programs.
  • Coordination with Contract Manufacturers: Coordinate the delivery with contract manufacturers (CMs) of products through the NX NPI process to ensure on-time “turn” for material procurement, product assembly, product testing, field testing, and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP).
Qualifications & Requirements
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).
  • 15+ years of experience in sourcing, supply chain, procurement, or supplier management within solar, renewable energy, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Proven track record in New Product Introduction (NPI) sourcing, supplier development, and cost negotiation.
Technical & Industry Knowledge
  • Deep understanding of global supply chain dynamics, supplier qualification, and commodity management.
  • Experience with mechanical and electrical components, raw materials, and contract manufacturing in the solar, energy, or hardware sectors.
  • Knowledge of PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) processes and familiarity with manufacturing techniques like stamping, casting, and welding.
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management skills to drive cost savings and ensure supply chain reliability.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and collaborate with engineering, operations, and finance teams.
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) and procurement tools.
  • Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Asian, European, and North American suppliers.
  • Familiarity with sustainability initiatives and compliance in the renewable energy sector.
  • Prior leadership experience in a hardware technology company, solar tracker, or related industry.
At Nextracker, we are leading in the energy transition, providing the most comprehensive portfolio of intelligent solar tracker and software solutions for solar power plants, as well as strategic services to capture the full value of solar power plants for our customers. Our talented worldwide teams are transforming PV plant performance every day with smart technology, data monitoring and analysis services.
For us at Nextracker, sustainability is not just a word. It's a core part of our business, values and our operations. Our sustainability efforts are based on five cornerstones: People, Community, Environment, Innovation, and Integrity. We are creative, collaborative and passionate problem-solvers from diverse backgrounds, driven by our shared mission to provide smart solar and software solutions for our customers and to mitigate climate change for future generations.
Culture is our Passion

  • Controllership of existing and new agreements with distributors, strategic partners, vendors, and Global manufacturing plants. Consolidation and reporting of budget for all regions. Analyze spending trends and provide recommendations for cost optimization.

  • 10+ years of experience in finance-roles, with at least 5 years leading multi-national teams in a Commercial Finance role, working closely with Global and cross functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Experience leading and inspiring teams fostering a collaborative and high performance culture
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint and working knowledge of financial planning systems such as Hyperion
  • Excellent knowledge of forecasting techniques
  • Strong accounting background, especially revenue/expense recognition rule with extensive experience in financial forecasting and modelling
  • Great data visualization and presentation skills to provide recommendations based on insight
  • Demonstrated proficiency in time and project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects across critical yet often fluctuating deadlines – and with sometimes minimal and/or ambiguous input from stakeholders.

Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.
Estamos procurando uma pessoa com forte expertise para atuar como Liderança Regional de Talent Acquisition (TA) para a América Latina, integrando nosso time global de liderança de Recrutamento e Seleção / Talent Acquisition.
Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para desenvolver e implementar a abordagem de TA na região LATAM, em alinhamento com a estratégia global, dentro de uma organização com estrutura matricial internacional.
A posição lidera uma equipe responsável pelos processos de recrutamento em vários países (Argentina, Brasil, Colômbia, México e Peru), com contribuição direta para os objetivos globais de atração e seleção de talentos.
Somos uma agência global de comunicação, responsável por construir, promover e proteger marcas e reputações de vários clientes. Entregamos trabalhos de qualidade, enquanto colaborando com uma rede de profissionais dedicados, em um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e focado em desenvolver o que há de melhor em cada um!
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégia: Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia abrangente de aquisição de talentos para a região LATAM, alinhada ao modelo global de talent acquisition. Essa estratégia deve incluir melhores práticas, inovação, iniciativas de DEI (Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão) e planejamento de força de trabalho.
  • Recrutamento Executivo: Conduzir processos completos de recrutamento de cargos de liderança sênior na região LATAM, com foco em identificar, atrair e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com talentos-chave.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Liderar iniciativas de gestão de mudanças para se adaptar às condições de mercado, novas tecnologias e tendências do setor. Implementar soluções inovadoras para aprimorar a experiência e a eficiência do processo de recrutamento.
  • Transformação: Liderar e apoiar esforços de transformação na área de talent acquisition, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Impulsionar melhorias contínuas em processos, ferramentas e metodologias.
  • Abordagem Baseada em Dados: Utilizar dados e análises para embasar decisões, acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de atração de talentos.
  • Engajamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com stakeholders regionais e globais para entender as necessidades de talentos e garantir uma experiência fluida e positiva para candidatos e gestores de contratação.
  • Especialização em Marca Empregadora: Conduzir com sucesso ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para posicionar a organização como empregadora de escolha, mantendo uma imagem forte e consistente em diferentes países.
  • Gestão de Equipe Regional: Liderar e orientar uma equipe geograficamente distribuída, demonstrando sensibilidade às dinâmicas culturais locais. Promover colaboração, oferecer suporte e garantir o cumprimento das metas de recrutamento.

Requisitos:
  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Talent Acquisition - profissional precisa ter o perfil especialista e não generalista;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes multiculturais e distribuídas geograficamente.
  • Vivência anterior em ambientes globais.
  • Histórico de condução de recrutamento executivo (C-level e diretoria), porém também fará posições de todos os outros níveis.
  • Atuação com transformação de processos, change management e employer branding.
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório) – uso constante em reportes e alinhamentos globais.

description:
O BEES é nosso aplicativo B2B, voltado a pequenos e médios varejistas do mundo todo. Usando o BEES, comerciantes e donos de bares de todo o mundo podem fazer pedidos para abastecer seus estoques, programar entregas, acessar dados do próprio negócio e muito mais.

No BEES, nosso sonho é um só: fazer nossas pessoas, nossos usuários e nossos parceiros prosperarem!

A AB InBev é a cervejaria líder global e uma das 5 principais empresas de produtos de consumo do mundo. Com mais de 500 marcas no portfólio, somos número um em muitos dos principais mercados de cerveja.

No Brasil, somos responsáveis por marcas como Brahma, Skol, Antarctica e Guaraná e temos muito orgulho em tornar o mundo um lugar com mais razões para brindar!

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Data Analytics Manager para liderar nosso time de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica, guiando e apoiando o time na entrega de soluções analíticas que impactam diretamente a nossa operação global. Se você gosta de dados, tem perfil analítico, espírito de liderança e gosta de transformar dados em insights acionáveis, essa vaga é pra você!

  • Gerenciar e liderar um time de alta performance de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica e promovendo mentorias e desenvolvimento do time.
  • Gerenciar um time de aproximadamente 5 a 10 pessoas, dependendo da alocação dos projetos.
  • Realizar revisões técnicas para garantir as melhores práticas, qualidade dos produtos de dados, além de recomendar as melhores fontes, modelos e métodos para cada caso de uso.
  • Atuar junto a times de produto, engenharia e estratégia comercial para construir uma estratégia unificada, orientada por dados.
  • Apoiar na priorização das demandas do time, junto aos stakeholders e data product managers, considerando impacto no negócio, esforço e prazos.
  • Conciliar atividades de liderança com desenvolvimento prático de produtos de dados, métricas e dashboards para geração de valor ao negócio.
  • Guiar a estratégia de negócio, fornecendo insights de performance atual e identificando oportunidades de crescimento a partir de análises avançadas, modelos estatísticos e preditivos.
  • Desenvolver datasets e schemas que integrem dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos internos, ferramentas de análise, fontes externas e não estruturadas).
  • Produzir narrativas e histórias com dados que direcionem ações, desenvolvendo visualizações e dashboards no Power BI.
  • Garantir o uso de métodos analíticos adequados para resolver problemas complexos.
  • Demonstrar domínio de modelos de dados, estruturas e boas práticas de governança de dados, apoiando os times de plataforma e engenharia nas melhores decisões técnicas.
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos e análises complexas de forma clara e efetiva para stakeholders e liderança, inclusive não técnica.

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Análise de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em gestão técnica de times de Data Analytics, além de sólida experiência em análise de dados e data science.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório) para atuar com times globais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com soluções em nuvem como Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery ou Teradata.
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI (DAX) e ferramentas de visualização. Tableau e Mode são diferenciais.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Python, PySpark e SQL. R será considerado um diferencial.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão crítica, raciocínio lógico e domínio de métodos estatísticos aplicados a negócios.
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos complexos, entendimento das necessidades do negócio e transformação desses requisitos em soluções de dados.
  • Experiência na análise de grandes volumes de dados, buscando insights, identificando gaps e inconsistências.
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e metodologias ágeis.
  • Vivência em utilização de dados transacionais e comportamentais para entender impactos no negócio e comportamento dos usuários, com foco em geração de ROI.

title: Lead Character Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Lead Character Artist to join our Fortnite Battle Royale team. In this position, you will lead and manage a team of Character Artists working on major initiatives within Fortnite. You will work directly with the art and design departments to help our team create and quickly iterate on exciting, purposeful characters that look amazing. You should have a combination of strong creative/visual aesthetics, excellent design skills, leadership experience, and a clear rendering style in modeling characters. You should be able to demonstrate that you can think outside the box and translate an awesome gameplay experience into an awesome visual experience as well as have experience creating stylized to semi-stylized characters.

In this role, you will

  • Create characters and enemies based on direction from the project Art Director and input from the game design team
  • Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of the Epic quality bar
  • Help Epic push the visual envelope by creating stunning and inspiring characters
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule
  • Partner with other departments such as Character Design or Concept Art team, to ensure the models work within the project workflow

What we're looking for

  • Ability to help mentor and coach a growing team of artists
  • Experience designing slick, detailed, modern, forward-looking 3D character assets
  • Experienced in game art asset creation in a variety of software packages including Maya, 3ds Max, Zbrush, Photoshop, Substance, etc. Experience with the Unreal Engine is a plus
  • A strong portfolio that showcases an eye for modern fashion-forward aesthetics that speak to our audience of teens and young adults
  • A mind for technical function and aesthetic pursuit with an ability to balance creativity with function
  • Ability to work within gameplay design restraints (environment scale, character abilities, prototype function, etc.) and translate those restrictions into visuals that enhance the experience
  • Experience creating mechanical designs
  • Strong traditional drawing skills and knowledge of the human anatomy
  • Strong understanding of color theory and how color affects mood & focal points
  • Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Nosso propósito é transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas, e pode ser o seu também!

Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Hoje, atuamos diariamente para transformar e descomplicar a gestão pública através do que há de melhor na tecnologia, com uma solução única e inteligente para gestão das cidades, seja na Contabilidade, na Saúde, na Educação, ou em mais de uma dezena de áreas.
A IPM é formada por mais de 600 pessoas apaixonadas pela inovação e transformação digital das cidades. Somos movidos por grandes desafios e pelo nosso impacto, e temos um sonho maior ainda: transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas através do melhor da tecnologia.
Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.
Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer.️
Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!
Nessa Vaga, Seu Desafio Será

  • Fornecer suporte técnico em sistemas no ambiente interno do cliente, ajudando a solucionar dúvidas relacionadas ao software e garantindo que sua experiência de uso seja satisfatória;

 Para essa posição, você vai precisar de:

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade de Campinas-SP, que, com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos hospitais mais tradicionais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e atendimento 24h. Além disso, atende mais de 66 especialidades e possui acreditação ONA 3 e certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, expandimos nossa rede em Campinas e região, inaugurando novos serviços como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, além da Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde e unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Adquirimos também a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um hospital de grande importância histórica na cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, e a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care, que, desde 2017, busca transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo de gestão inovador, promovendo o equilíbrio entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas, por meio de um sistema completo de hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Atuamos em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina, com o objetivo de nos tornarmos a melhor rede de prestadores de saúde privada do Brasil.

title: Solutions Consultant (Sales Engineer/Pre-sales)
description:
Are you ready to drive impactful solutions in fraud prevention and risk management?
Do you have experience in fraud detection and prevention, and want to shape pre-sales strategies?
The main responsibility of the Solutions Consultant is to support sales efforts by collaborating with the client, account manager, and sales representative to assess the technical needs and solution design fit, developing scoping documents and operational workflows while showing our solutions' value to prospects/customers. This professional supports sales productivity and deal flow by assisting sales in securing a deal in complex and multidisciplinary environments. Collaborates with sales, product management, operations, and engineering to ensure proposed deals include solutions that accurately address customer needs and exceed the requirements of the decision/business-makers.
Responsibilities

  • Using your understanding of fraud detection and risk management, provide advice and support to clients on fraud prevention systems, processes, and regulations.
  • Provide product demonstrations to potential customers, highlighting fraud detection and prevention capabilities.
  • Conduct workshops to gather and analyze client requirements, recommending fraud prevention solutions.
  • Proactively scope and document the technical solution and project plan required to address prospective customer requirements in fraud prevention.
  • Coordinate with services delivery teams to ensure the scoped solution is staffed and implemented according to the expectations set with the customer.
  • Secure commitments from the customer’s technical staff to ensure the deal meets the technical requirements to close.
  • Understand profit and loss analysis in multiple markets and industries, making sound business decisions by developing ROI models and analysis based on this data.
  • Business case development: responsible for compiling or developing all sections of a business case, which may include customer objectives, input data summary, data quality summary, process and performance tables (including how the process compares to industry standards), financial analysis, and conclusions/next steps.
  • Interact regularly with customers (both internal and external) to provide thought leadership, business expertise, and guidance related to fraud prevention solutions.
  • Contribute to the development of sales presentations, proposals, and other client-facing materials by providing frequent market/customer feedback to vertical and product representatives.
  • Maintain a current understanding of competitor offerings (i.e., price, product, service, or solution) so that you can effectively sell the advantages over that offered by its competitors.
  • Contribute to Thought Leadership in the form of blogs, articles, white papers.
Requirements
  • Experience in cyber security and enterprise architectures. Understanding of authentication, fraud, ATO, CNP is a plus.
  • Risk management/credit policy experience
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Spanish would be desirable too, but not mandatory)
  • Deep understanding of the OSI model, especially as it pertains to HTTP, TCP, and SSL.
  • Deep understanding of authentication methodologies: 2FA/MFA, biometrics, and risk-based authentication.
  • General understanding of security frameworks.
  • Outstanding oral and written communication skills; effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences; experience in preparing clear, concise business case documentation
  • Strong presentation skills and required to create custom market facing presentations. Highly proficient analytical and problem solving skills to understand the problem/issue that the customer needs to have solved - involving in depth research, asking correct probing questions, drawing valid conclusions and identifying risks.
  • Work with the salesperson in a team environment acting as the strategist/quarterback: Absorb pre-meeting background, and tailor meeting content appropriately.
  • Determine what the client is really asking for in a sales or technical presentation and then answer credibly and concisely.
  • Engineering/Development (back-end and or mobile) experience is a plus.
  • Travel at least 25%
Preferred Qualifications
  • Certifications related to fraud prevention or risk management (e.g., CFE – Certified Fraud Examiner, etc.).
  • Experience conducting fraud risk reviews, identifying red flags, and utilizing additional external sources for fraud detection.
  • Familiarity with technologies and tools used to track and prevent fraud activities.
  • Experience working with orchestration platforms for fraud prevention.
  • Knowledge of relevant standards and regulations for fraud risk management.
Location: São Paulo, Brazil
This role offers a hybrid work arrangement, with one day per week in the office.

Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
 Position Summary:
The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.
Role & Responsibilities:

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM's BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM's Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software's LegaSuite application over Netcracker's ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS
Required Skills & Experience:
  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure "switch readiness" on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)
Other Highly Desired Skills:
  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode
Education:

Orgulhosamente, somos um dos principais bancos do Brasil. Aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Estamos sempre em busca de melhorias, aprendizado contínuo e inovação. Procuramos pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por mudanças, que tenham vontade de aprender e queiram crescer no mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Uma história de mais de 60 anos de solidez e inovação.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.

Hoje, temos orgulho em ser um dos principais bancos do Brasil. O motivo disso é incentivar e acreditar no empreendedor brasileiro, fortalecendo relacionamentos apoiados na ética e no respeito. Um dos fatores que nos destacam no mercado é o comprometimento dos nossos colaboradores, com forte espírito empreendedor e uma paixão que os fazem vestir a camisa como se fossem donos. É essa mesma motivação que nos leva a prêmios e conquistas notáveis, como o de Melhor Banco do Brasil, em um ranking realizado pela Forbes, no ano de 2023.

Por aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Acreditamos que sempre podemos melhorar, aprender, investir e buscar o novo. A melhora contínua é um processo diário. Em 2011, inauguramos uma nova categoria de serviços bancários no Brasil, lançando o primeiro banco digital de investimentos: o Sofisa Direto. Com isso, encontramos a oportunidade ideal para manter os nossos clientes motivados a buscar os seus objetivos. Em toda a história, os negócios do Banco Sofisa foram construídos por uma sólida estrutura financeira, assegurada por altos índices de capitalização, fazendo com que os nossos clientes sintam-se seguros, investindo em ativos de qualidade, que muitas das vezes só se encontram por aqui.

Hoje, podemos dizer que vencemos o maior de todos os testes, o teste do tempo. E se esse teste foi vencido, é porque valorizamos quem realmente importa: você, nosso cliente. Cada obstáculo superado, cada desafio vencido são os fundamentos da solidez e a experiência que precisamos para seguir em frente.
